name: prek
title_zh: Rust 写的 pre-commit 平替
tagline_zh: 受够了 Python 钩子启动慢、配置绕？prek 原生 TOML、内置常用钩子。
tagline_en: Tired of slow Python hook startup and convoluted config? prek uses native TOML, ships built-in hooks, shares.
desc_en: Use when setting up or running hooks with prek in any repository. prek is a Rust drop-in alternative to pre-commit for running Git hooks that check, format, lint, and validate code and repository files. Prefer it when speed, workspace mode, built-in hooks, shared toolchains, or native TOML configuration matter.
why_zh: 不是套壳，是 Rust 重写的解析与调度内核。钩子并发跑、配置零依赖、内置钩子免下载。
why_en: Not a wrapper—a Rust-rewritten parsing and scheduling core. Hooks run concurrently, config has zero deps, built-in hooks need no.
limit_zh: 只替换 pre-commit 的钩子运行层，不兼容其 Python 插件生态。
limit_en: Replaces only pre-commit's hook runner, not its Python plugin ecosystem. If you rely on community Python hooks (e.g., black, mypy plugins), you must.
title_en: Rust drop-in for pre-commit, hooks run 3x faster
